title: US Treasury yields rise after three-day fall as oil jumps, Fed decision looms - The Economic Times
text:
As oil prices surged, treasury yields took notice, raising inflation worries in the market. Traders are keeping a watchful eye on the Federal Reserve's expected decision to maintain interest rates today. Nonetheless, traders are fully anticipating a hike in September, with a solid possibility of another increase before the year's end.

On Wednesday, Indian government bonds took a hit due to renewed U.S. airstrikes in the Middle East, escalating tensions in the Gulf region. This escalation has led to a spike in oil prices and increased U.S. Treasury yields. The rising crude prices pose challenges for India's inflation, fiscal health, and current account. Investors can expect high global yields to continue, limiting the potential for rallies in Indian fixed income markets.
